data.content:
Implemented on branch worktree-knots-ec23-push-unblock, commit d555e5cebc37, pushed to origin. Branch: worktree-knots-ec23-push-unblock.

WHAT CHANGED
- src/replication.rs: removed require_no_active_leases from push_with_progress (comment explains why: immutable uuidv7-named event files, already durable locally). pull and pull_with_progress keep the guard verbatim. sync_or_defer_with_progress now pushes FIRST, then counts local active leases; on a non-zero count it emits a ProgressKind::Warn line and returns Deferred { active_leases, push }, otherwise it pulls and returns Completed. It builds ReplicationSummary inline rather than delegating to sync_with_progress, which is what lets the deferred arm keep the push result.
- NEW src/replication/summary.rs: PushSummary, ReplicationSummary and SyncOutcome moved here (re-exported from src/replication.rs, so every crate::replication::* path is unchanged), plus PushSummary::render and SyncOutcome::render. This carve-out was mandatory: replication.rs was 497/499 lines and run_commands.rs hit 501 when the deferred branch grew, so moving the rendering into the type that owns the data fixed both (replication.rs 486, run_commands.rs 465).
- SyncOutcome::Deferred gained a push: PushSummary field. Purely additive JSON: {"status":"deferred","active_leases":N,"push":{...}}.
- src/run_commands.rs: run_sync now just prints outcome.render().
- src/bin/kno_mcp/sync_loop.rs: deferred_sync_detail renders "active_leases=N pull deferred; push(copied_files=M pushed=B)", keeping the status=deferred and completed->None fallbacks.
- src/sync/mod.rs: ActiveLeasesExist now reads "N active lease(s) found; terminate leases before pulling (push is never blocked by leases)" -- the plan-review addendum, since only pull raises it now. src/sync/error_tests.rs updated.
- Docs: docs/leases.md gains a "Push is never blocked" section with the new text and JSON output, and its lease-blocking claims are now pull-specific; README.md and TAXONOMY.md (lease, replication, sync outcome entries) corrected too.

TESTS (verification steps 1-4)
- V1: src/replication/tests.rs push_blocks_with_active_leases renamed to push_succeeds_with_active_leases_but_pull_blocks; push -> Ok, pull -> ActiveLeasesExist(1), sync -> is_active_leases, sync_or_defer -> Deferred carrying the push summary.
- V1b: tests_lease_owner.rs lease_owned_by_this_machine_still_blocks_sync renamed to ..._blocks_the_pull_half and flipped the same way.
- V2: NEW src/replication/tests_push_unblocked.rs (nested in the replication::tests module so it reuses setup_origin_and_dev1/unique_workspace; tests.rs was already 462 lines). Authors a real note event, holds an owner-less active lease, calls sync_or_defer, asserts Deferred with local_event_files=1 copied_files=1 committed pushed commit.is_some(), and then proves the bytes actually landed by git cat-file-ing the blob off the origin's configured knots ref (asserted absent beforehand).
- V3: three deferred_sync_detail tests in sync_loop.rs -- push-succeeded shape, no-op push shape, and the existing missing-count/completed cases.
- NEW src/replication/summary_tests.rs: render for both arms plus the deferred JSON shape (summary.rs went 6/10 -> 10/10 lines covered).

VERIFICATION ACTUALLY RUN
- make sanity green twice: once manually (1277 tests, 95.14%) and again via the managed pre-push hook on push. .ci/coverage-threshold.txt untouched at 95.
- Manual check against target/debug/knots in a throwaway repo with a bare origin: with a lease LEASE_ACTIVE, kno push published 11 event files and reported pushed=true; git ls-tree confirmed the events on refs/heads/knots; kno pull refused with the reworded message; kno sync printed "sync push(local_event_files=11 copied_files=0 committed=false pushed=false) pull deferred: 1 active lease(s)" and kno sync --json emitted the deferred object with the nested push summary.
- No branch CI exists (CI runs on pull_request and pushes to main only), so local sanity is the implementation gate; CI will run on main at shipment.
